records.real_world_identity_notes: The exact content documentation identifies a 1965 Ford GT40 Mk I. The real-car baseline is the small-block Ford GT40 Mk I used in 1965 endurance racing, including the 289/4.7-litre competition specification and ZF 5DS-25 five-speed transaxle. This is not the 1966 GT40 Mk II with its larger 427 engine and four-speed Kar Kraft/Ford transmission, and it is not a road-only GT40 configuration.
records.confidence_basis: The WSC Legends pack names the installed content 1965 Ford GT40 Mk I and describes its Ford GT40/Mk I race history. Ford's historical material establishes the GT40 program and distinguishes the later Mk II, while 1965 Le Mans entry data identifies Ford GT40 cars with ZF 5DS-25 five-speed gearboxes.

records.specification_basis: Ford's historical document identifies the 1965 adoption of the five-speed ZF transaxle; exact 1965 Le Mans data lists ZF 5DS-25 five-speed GT40 entries; the Mk-I guide and ZF replacement documentation corroborate five forward speeds. The exact-Mk-I technical guide describes the ZF DS25 as all-synchromesh; Quaife identifies its replacement as replicating the original ZF DS-25/2 and describes synchromesh selection. This is medium confidence because the primary 1965 event table names the ZF gearbox but does not itself state the synchronizer construction. The manufacturer replacement documentation explicitly identifies the original ZF DS-25/2 layout as five-speed H-pattern, and the Mk-I guide documents the corresponding right-hand gear change. Quaife states that the original ZF DS-25/2 has a distinctive dog-leg first-gear location, but the reviewed evidence does not establish which side first gear occupies. The database therefore keeps the complete shift pattern unknown. The reviewed sources did not establish the remaining technique and wheel fields, which stay unknown in the real-car baseline: /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/integrated_display, /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/open_top, /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/shape, /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/shift_lights, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/automatic_blip, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/automatic_cut, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/clutch, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/manual_blip, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/throttle_lift, /authentic_controls/transmission/first_gear_position, /authentic_controls/transmission/shift_pattern, /authentic_controls/transmission/standing_start_clutch, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/automatic_blip, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/automatic_cut, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/clutch, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/manual_blip, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/throttle_lift.
